title: GTM Discoveries — Category-Tagged Signals
$comment: Per Phase 2 architectural pivot (memory/project_gtm_campaign_architecture.md) + BC-8722. Skills emit category-tagged signals to docs/campaigns/{entity}/{slug}/discoveries.json; humans promote to handbook canonicals (plugins/marketing/data/canonicals/) or to handbook prose via PR. BC-8726 (T9-X icp-refinement-review) operationalizes the review step downstream. Brite repo is stdlib-only — this schema is the declarative contract; plugins/marketing/scripts/lint_discoveries.py is the runtime enforcement (it mirrors the constraints below).
description: A discoveries.json file is a per-campaign-run signal log. One file per campaign at docs/campaigns/{entity}/{slug}/discoveries.json. Append-only by convention (operator workflow); each signal carries a category from the locked 4-category enum (title-discovery / icp-refinement / offer-retirement / persona-discovery), a timestamp, the emitting skill, a free-shape payload, and a promotion lifecycle status (pending / promoted / rejected).

schema_version.description: Pinned to the linter's SCHEMA_VERSION constant. Bump in lockstep with the linter + data shape.

signals.description: Append-only signal list. May be empty for a freshly-initialized file.

category.description: Load-bearing identifier; BC-8726 (icp-refinement-review) reads these strings. Keep stable. The 4 categories lock at BC-8722; a 5th (e.g. vertical-discovery) is V3-gated and would ship as a follow-up BC.

emitted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g., 2026-05-22T14:30:00Z). Producer-stamped at emit time; not re-stamped on review.

payload.description: Free-shape, category-specific. Skills name expected fields in their SKILL.md Discoveries sections; the schema does not constrain payload contents.

promotion_status.description: Lifecycle: pending (default — awaiting human review) → promoted (incorporated into handbook canonicals / prose via PR) → rejected (operator declined). The lint does not enforce a default at the data layer — absence is treated as pending by consumers.
